display_long_description:
Drunk Or Dead 2 is a fast-paced VR action shooter where unstable survival enhancements keep you alive.

A brutal zombie plague wiped out civilization. Only those affected by strange experimental substances survived, gaining unpredictable but powerful side effects. These effects fuel your abilities, alter combat flow, and force you to balance risk and control every time you leave safety.

Your gameplay loop is simple and deadly: gear up, venture into hostile zones, fight through zombies, loot scarce supplies and bizarre ingredients, then decide whether to retreat or push deeper for greater rewards.

Combat is built for VR from the ground up. Aim, shoot, reload, and react under pressure using a wide arsenal of weapons. Not all enemies are mindless — Neurozombies can aim, shoot, and punish bad positioning.

Progress through an episodic experience with 10 planned chapters.

In this world, every bullet, every effect, and every bad decision counts.
